name: OTP Authenticator App
blurb: KeyVault is a secure 2FA/OTP manager that helps you store and manage all your two-factor authentication codes and time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) in one secure location.
description:
KeyVault is a secure 2FA/OTP manager that helps you store and manage all your two-factor
authentication codes and time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) in one secure location.

All data is stored locally and only on your devices. This app can be used as-is or, manually sync
2FA codes from one device to another with the import/export tool.

KeyVault also has an Android and Windows version which allows you to import/export your codes
with ease and with encryption (offline).

Features:

• Secure storage for all your 2FA and OTP tokens (keys are stored on device, never online)

• Automatic TOTP code generation

• Easy organization of authentication codes

• Cross-platform support (Android, Windows available, with Mac and iPhone coming soon)

Pro Features (unlocked with KeyVault Pro License on Android)

• Create and categorize your OTP codes

• Customize your OTP codes with colors and icons

• Personalize KeyVault OTP app with custom themes

• Activate PIN for security

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
